```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import libpysal
from pysal.explore import esda

# Load the dataset
DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/cyclehire_w000.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)

# Load the adjacency matrix
adj_df = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)
w = libpysal.weights.util.graph2w(adj_df, idVariable='id')

# Prepare the variable of interest (assuming 'count' is the column name)
y = df['count'].values

# Calculate Moran's I
moran = esda.moran.Moran(y, w)

# Print results
print('Moran\'s I:', moran.I)
print('p-value:', moran.p_value)
```
